title: Limit Members Shown on the Streaming Members Section
breadcrumbs: Limit Members Shown on the Streaming Members Section
content:
## Limit Members Shown on the Streaming Members Section


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097951

The Streaming Members section on the homepage can be configured to display members from specific Membership Plans only.


## Limiting the Displayed Membership Plans


- Log in to the Admin Area.

- Navigate to Settings → Design Settings .

- Open the Homepage tab.

- Scroll to the Select Content to Display section and expand it.

- Locate the Streaming Members module and click Edit Settings .

- Find the Limit Members Shown to These Membership Plans setting.

- Select the Membership Plans whose members should appear in the Streaming Members section.

- Click Save Changes .

Only members assigned to the selected Membership Plans will be displayed in the homepage's Streaming Members section.
